ideas.title: Following the Money: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent overhaul of the Minnesota Medicaid system and potential fraud within the system.
questions: What are the potential vulnerabilities in the Medicaid system?
How effective is the proposed overhaul in preventing fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse within the Medicaid system. By analyzing data and conducting interviews, we can shed light on the extent of the problem and the effectiveness of the proposed overhaul.
